# Qrisp MLIR dialect definitions

`include/Jasp/IR/JaspDialect.td` and `JaspOps.td` are derived from the Eclipse
Qrisp repository at commit `8408b32caa64f014228e567e2dbf1849e3b1e009`.
They are used under Qrisp's `EPL-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception`
license. The authoritative license text is available in the upstream
repository at <https://github.com/eclipse-qrisp/Qrisp/blob/main/LICENSE>.

The local definitions retain Qrisp's assembly compatibility and add the C++
measurement verifier required by this converter.
